headlines: Japan's finance minister Katayama said the government is discussing the defense budget.
Hang Seng Index futures opened the day session down 0.81% at 23,963, trading 224 points below the cash index.
Japan's finance minister Katayama said she will consider measures to secure stable funding sources while monitoring fiscal sustainability.
Japan's finance minister Katayama said no decision has been made on how to fund the expected increase in defense spending.
Japan's Nikkei 225 fell below 64,000 points, down 1.42% intraday.
